label: small shield
ours: sneed's shields (2026-11-15, docs/design/shields.md): a tower shield is a chest piece of its tier (steel plate armour's %s), each size down halves it; mitigation is steel's, scaled by armourStuff; mass and flat block by shieldStuff
gear.shield.catchChance: the chance a hit from the front lands on the raised shield
